name: CXOU J085201.4-461753
notes: Adopt age 1.6–5.1 kyr and Ho2026 cool-surface luminosity 1.3–4.0 × 10^32 erg/s as error bars only. name: PSR J0205+6449
notes: Age 0.8–7 kyr retained (decision 2026-11-20): young decelerating models (Kothes 2013) and several-kyr optical/radio scenarios; 0.8 is a rounded continuity choice, not the minimum of Kothes, and 7 kyr is a PWN expansion timescale, not a rigorous upper bound (for steady PWN growth R ∝ t^1.2 inside freely expanding ejecta, t ≈ 1.2 × 7 ≈ 8.4 kyr). SN 1181 is not assumed; Pa 30 is its likely remnant. Luminosity (0.8–3.4) × 10³² erg/s: the small-area lower edge 2 × 10³¹ is removed; single interval, no split by spectral interpretation. The conditional hidden-surface limit < 10²⁸ erg/s (kT ≈ 4 eV) is not plotted. Open: check whether the Kothes 0.63–1.6 kyr range is derived independently of the 1181 date. No common confidence level or equal endpoint weights.
